purpose: Generate useful higher-density candidate sleeves directly from every causal M5 decision row rather than attempting to rescue failed hand-written structural candidates.

universe.decision_rows: every completed M5 bar after full causal feature warmup
universe.risk_unit: ATR14 from last closed M15 bar
universe.label: unchanged 6-hour TP1.5 SL1.0 exact-M1 bid/ask label with Strong and Extreme costs

mutually_exclusive_sleeves.TREND: remaining rows with abs(H1 EMA20-EMA50 gap / H1 ATR14) >= 0.25 and H4 gap has the same sign or is within 0.10 ATR of neutral

direction_normalization: Price-directional features are multiplied by +1 for LONG and -1 for SHORT; absolute volatility and shape features are unchanged.

model_grid.classifier: LGBMClassifier n_estimators=300 learning_rate=0.03 num_leaves=15 min_child_samples=100 reg_lambda=2
LGBMClassifier n_estimators=500 learning_rate=0.025 num_leaves=31 min_child_samples=150 reg_lambda=5
XGBClassifier n_estimators=400 max_depth=3 learning_rate=0.03 min_child_weight=20 subsample=0.8 colsample_bytree=0.8 reg_lambda=5

score.reference_distribution: training-period prediction distribution for the same direction and sleeve

chronology.confirmation: refit selected unchanged algorithm on all rows resolved by 2025-01-01, apply unchanged score formula and percentile retention to 2025
chronology.diagnostic: refit selected unchanged algorithm on all rows resolved by 2026-01-01, apply unchanged configuration to 2026

one_position.entry_rule: admit only when prior admitted exit_time <= current decision_time
one_position.same_decision_cross_sleeve: regimes are mutually exclusive per direction
one_position.long_short_simultaneous: reported separately and portfolio-arbitrated only after confirmation

selection_gate_2024.objective_after_gate: maximize minimum of Strong and Extreme PF, then Strong PF, positive rate, Strong R, count and lower complexity
